translations.web: Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
translations.bsb: If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
translations.kjv: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
